reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because it actively promotes purchasing OneCoin investment packages through a registration link while presenting highly specific minimum returns, including €50,000 or €250,000 after three years from €1,000 or €5,000 investments. It also encourages active participation in a partnership and bonus structure, including direct-sales and binary bonuses, and uses urgency and action-oriented messaging to drive enrollment.

citations.quote: So there is a new opportunity. OneCoin is an innovative, safe and real cryptocurrency.
For three years, the currency Rises by about 100 times to 50 Euro.

The company has a partnership program and look further how you can earn with this business. Bonus plan. Company has bonuses. Bonus direct sales, bonus network, matchin-bonus, startup bonus, bonus club life, bonus gold, and program leadership.

opening.argument: The presentation presents an investment discussion and leaves the decision with the viewer rather than asserting that participation is mandatory or risk-free. It explicitly says, “It's up to you,” and asks viewers to choose an investment amount based on their own future needs. The material also distinguishes between options and describes a concept in abbreviated form, which supports reading it as conditional financial commentary rather than a deceptive guarantee.

citations.quote: To be your own expert, it would be worth to working on this project now? It's up to you.
It's really important to determine the amount of your investment based on the amount you need in a year or in 3 years
This is a shortened version of this concept and you can find a more detailed version in my other videos

rebuttal.rebuttal: The opposing account treats projected figures as proof of deception, but the cited material does not establish that the figures were guaranteed or that viewers were compelled to invest. “Innovative, safe and real cryptocurrency” is a characterization of the product, while the presentation still leaves the investment decision to the viewer. A forecast or promotional estimate can be disputed without converting the whole presentation into a scam.

citations.quote: OneCoin is an innovative, safe and real cryptocurrency.
It's up to you.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The qualification “It's up to you” does not make the message a warning or balanced analysis. The same presentation tells viewers to select an investment based on desired future money while displaying concrete minimum returns. Its language presents the opportunity as safe and real, not as an uncertain forecast requiring independent verification.

opening.argument: The video's structure is consistent with an educational introduction to cryptocurrency and a business concept. It explains what cryptocurrency is, gives Bitcoin's history and market examples, describes how the proposed system would operate, and lays out several development stages. The speaker calls this a shortened version of a broader concept, indicating presentation of an idea and its mechanics rather than a narrowly targeted deception. The viewer is invited to learn more, not shown a completed transaction or guaranteed outcome.

citations.quote: What is a cryptocurrency? That is a digital currency that uses cryptography in order to secure our money and be able to make a living.
when was it profitable to invest in bitcoin
Four Stage of OneCoin Concepts
This is a shortened version of this concept and you can find a more detailed version in my other videos

rebuttal.rebuttal: Calling the material a concept presentation does not erase its instructional content. It explains cryptocurrency, compares Bitcoin's past movement, describes planned stages and payment use, and discusses how participation could work. Those are recognizable educational and explanatory features. A registration invitation at the end can direct viewers to further information without proving that the entire video is a fraudulent solicitation.

citations.quote: What is a cryptocurrency?
Four Stage of OneCoin Concepts
Find the link in the description. i'll help you and tell you what to do next.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The educational material is subordinate to a direct investment pitch. The video gives specific returns for specific investments, lists packages, explains payment methods, and asks viewers to register for business instructions. Explaining cryptocurrency terminology or stages does not change the function of those claims: they make the proposed investment appear profitable and actionable.

citations.quote: if you invest 5 thousand euro, in three years they will turn into € 250,000.
The minimum investment size is 100 €, the maximum size is not limited
click on the description and subscribe

opening.argument: The material can be read as promotion of a commercial cryptocurrency project and its associated packages, services, and participation options. It describes a company, an exchange, payment methods, registration assistance, and a minimum investment size, all of which are ordinary features of presenting a business opportunity. The record does not show a request for passwords, identity documents, or other credentials, nor does it establish that a completed payment or a specific victim occurred. The presence of optimistic promotion alone does not prove a scam mechanism.

citations.quote: The company has developed a one-exchange exchange on which you always can purchase the one-coin.
The minimum investment size is 100 €, the maximum size is not limited
PAYMENTS Direct banking transfer, MasterCard card, Visa, PerfectMoney
Find the link in the description. i'll help you and tell you what to do next.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The opposing account emphasizes returns and bonuses, but those features can also appear in commercial business and referral promotions. The evidence establishes an advertised cryptocurrency project, packages, payment options, and a partnership program; it does not establish a hidden deposit process, credential theft, or a completed transaction. The presentation's commercial nature therefore supports ordinary business promotion as an alternative interpretation.

citations.quote: The company has a partnership program and look further how you can earn with this business.
PAYMENTS Direct banking transfer, MasterCard card, Visa, PerfectMoney

true_side_reply.rebuttal: This is not merely a retail product description. The presentation solicits investment packages, promises minimum income tied to the amount invested, and adds direct-sales and binary bonuses. The absence of a password request or completed victim is immaterial because promotional scam content can operate by persuading viewers to send money; the video explicitly supplies payment routes and registration instructions.
